dict.string: Stride shows your Apple Watch runs live on iPhone, with heart rate and effort zones, and can read your weight and date of birth to estimate calories and set your heart-rate zones.
Stride saves your runs to Apple Health.
Stride uses your location to map your route and measure distance and pace while you run.
Stride uses your location to keep recording your run while your iPhone is locked.
Precise location is needed to measure your distance and pace accurately during this run.
